mu_name_from: MuMain _enum.h MONSTER_DARK_PHOENIX (77), drawn as MODEL_DARK_PHEONIX_SHIELD (MONSTER_MODEL_DARK_PHOENIX_SHIELD = 55, Monster56.bmd, the bird) with Monster57.bmd (MONSTER_MODEL_DARK_PHOENIX = 56, the rider) over it. OpenMU Version095d Maps/Icarus.cs:389 names breed 77 'Dark Phoenix'; WZO files it under bosses (Monster.txt:76). One spot, 34,238. docs/icarus-port.md.
monster_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:13640-13648, CreateMonster, case MONSTER_DARK_PHOENIX: OpenMonsterModel(SHIELD) and (PHOENIX); CreateCharacter(MODEL_DARK_PHEONIX_SHIELD); NotRotateOnMagicHit; Scale = 1.0f; StreamMesh = 0 on the bird. RenderCharacter's MONSTER_DARK_PHOENIX arm (:8890-8925) draws the bird's chrome pulse, the bird again as BlendMesh 0 at a breathing 0.3-0.6, then `o->Type++` -- the rider, Monster57, on its own clip at the same action and frame -- with a CPhysicsCloth mane (magic_H.tga) on the rider's bone 10. Its effects, in game/play (kDarkPhoenixFigure): its Energy Ball's bolt from the bird's head at CheckAttackTime(14), a MODEL_PIERCING + 1 and a BITMAP_JOINT_THUNDER to the target (:2108-2121), drawn as a monster's Lightning, every plain blow a bolt that pushes (sim kBoltBlowers); its boss blow, 40 BITMAP_JOINT_SPIRIT sub 3 at CheckAttackTime(2) and (6) (:1785-1800), ours one Evil Spirit release. Left out: the chrome pulse, the cloth mane, the shield's phase -- WZ's Soul Barrier every 6 s and the rider's four BITMAP_JOINT_THUNDER from her hand while it is up (:2283-2293; WZ user.cpp:25410-25430) -- and the bolt's MODEL_PIERCING + 1.
mesh_from: Both bodies in one, made with pipeline/merge_rigs.py: MuExtract's Monster56 export (61 bones, Pnix, 1054 triangles) then Monster57's (48 bones renamed 'Rider ...', magic_BB, 646), each action's tracks the bird's then the rider's -- MU plays both at one action and frame, and their seven actions have the same keys, 8, 8, 8, 7, 7, 4, 19.
rig_from: Exported with --actions=all from both models and merged, 7 actions, 109 bones. Its death plays at 0.22 (ZzzOpenData.cpp:3782-3792, the shield's case falling through into the phoenix's), in actions.json's action_overrides for model 55.
sheet_from: Data/Monster's Pnix.OZJ (256 square, a lava of red and gold, the bird) and magic_BB.OZT (64 square, the rider's dark navy, its alpha cutting 10% in slots), under a phoenix_ prefix.
sheet_materials_from: The bird is a glow, so its material only names it; the rider's dark robe, cloth.
glow_from: MU draws the bird solid, its mesh 0 a StreamMesh sliding V at WorldTime * 0.0001 (MoveCharacterVisual :5822-5824, a tenth of the sheet a second), then again added at BlendMesh 0 and a breathing 0.3-0.6. Ours: drawn added alone, sliding, a bird of flowing fire on Icarus's navy that still casts half a shadow.
soft_alpha_from: magic_BB.OZT is drawn by MU tested and blended (EnableAlphaTest).
sounds_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:3782-3787: SetMonsterSound(..., 183, 184, 185, 185, -1): mPhoenix1 to move (184, a second load of it), mPhoenixAttack1 to attack, and no death sound (mDarkPhoenixDie is commented out). Wired as darkphoenix_move/attack in sounds.json.
